scripts.bootstrap: npm run bootstrap:web && npm run bootstrap:api
scripts.lint:api: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/src apps/api/tests apps/api/migrations
scripts.format:api: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project apps/api ruff format apps/api/src apps/api/tests apps/api/migrations
scripts.demo:list: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project demo python demo/src/risktrace_demo_cli.py list
scripts.demo:convert: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project demo python demo/src/risktrace_demo_cli.py convert
scripts.demo:replay: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project demo python demo/src/risktrace_demo_cli.py replay
scripts.lint:demo: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project apps/api ruff check demo/src demo/tests --config apps/api/pyproject.toml
scripts.test:demo: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project demo python -m unittest discover -s demo/tests
scripts.migrate: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init
scripts.check: npm run lint:web && npm run typecheck:web && npm run build:web && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:demo && npm run test:api && npm run test:demo
